title: John Beresford
html_source:
John Beresford (1738 – 1805) PC, PC (Ire) was an Irish statesman. In 1786, he was sworn a member of the Privy Council of Great Britain, and the power which he wielded in Ireland through his numerous dependants and connections grew to be so extensive that a few years later he was spoken of as the ‘King of Ireland’. He was a vehement opponent of the increasing demand for Catholic Emancipation;
